title: peering/rate_limit PeerRateLimiter keyed by String not IpAddr
description: In crates/transit/src/peering/rate_limit.rs, PeerRateLimiter is keyed by String (peer address including port). Two connections from the same IP on different ephemeral ports each get an independent bucket, defeating per-IP rate limiting. Key should be IpAddr parsed from the address string. Also, entry(peer_addr.to_owned()) allocates a String on every call including cache hits.
